tools.name: graph_upsert
tools.description:
Fold new facts into a memory graph and get the whole graph back. FREE.

Idempotent by construction: re-adding the same entity, observation or
relation changes nothing, so an agent that replays its own history does not
end up with a graph full of duplicates. Typical input {"graph": {"entities":
[], "

tools.name: graph_search
tools.description:
Find what the graph knows about something, plus its neighbourhood. FREE.

Scores entities by how many query words appear in the name, type and
observations, then pulls in whatever is within the requested number of
hops - because the useful answer to "what do we know about Acme" is
usually Acme plus

tools.name: graph_diff
tools.description:
Say exactly what changed between two versions of a memory. FREE.

The audit trail a database gives you for free, without the database.
Typical input {"before": {...}, "after": {...}} returns

"observations_added": {"Acme Corp": ["renewed in Mar

tools.name: graph_lint
tools.description:
Find the breaks a memory graph accumulates as it grows. FREE.

Relations pointing at entities that do not exist, entities nothing points
at, near-duplicate names, and observations that contradict each other on
the same entity. Typical input {"graph": {...}} returns {"ok": false,
"dangling_relations"

tools.name: graph_at_time
tools.description:
See the memory as it stood on a given day, optionally faded by age. PREMIUM (license).

Relations carrying since and until are filtered to those in force on the
date; with a half-life, confidence decays exponentially with age so a

tools.name: graph_compact
tools.description:
Shrink a memory to the part that still earns its place. PREMIUM (license).

Ranks entities by how connected they are and how much is recorded about
them, keeps anything you name outright, and drops the rest along with the
relations that pointed at them. Typical input {"graph": {...},
"max_entities":
